title: Valerse-Modpack
description: a mod pack made for people suffering from less fps but Valerse aims to improve your fps and make you a better player
body:
# What is Valerse?
Valerse enhances your FPS and gameplay with carefully selected mods discovered through extensive research.

# What makes Valerse unique?
Unlike popular modpacks like Simply Optimized, Valerse includes more mods and incorporates PvP enhancements.

# Warning
Valerse (60+ mods) is only compatible with the Modrinth App / Modrinth Client , ATlauncher , Prism launcher. It will crash on clients like Feather and Lunar.

## Thanks for reading
